Built-in image generation. Reference-driven monochrome UI artwork.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one square Egyptian game minimap frame as a production UI asset. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE only: match its black and white hand-engraved ink, coarse stippling, carved pale stone, small lotus and papyrus motifs. A coherent SQUARE frame viewed perfectly straight on, outer edge fills entire square canvas with 2% margin. Very large absolutely empty square black aperture from x14% to86%, y14% to86%. Frame thickness only 12%. Corners carved lotus rosettes, side posts finely hatched stone with small ankhs, restrained winged sun centered in top rail, matching small geometric bottom rail. No circles, no gauges, no map, no symbols inside aperture, no text, no letters, no numbers, no game scene. Interior solid black, exterior transparent. Fine detail must survive at 220px display. Strictly monochrome black and white, no grey gradients, no gold. Exact square proportions, not perspective.
